subthemes.name: Connecting images and text
subthemes.gist: Teaching models to understand the relationship between what they see in images and what words mean, so they answer questions and describe pictures accurately.

subthemes.name: Making sense of video
subthemes.gist: Helping models understand what happens over time in videos, track changes, and answer questions about video content without watching every single frame.

subthemes.name: Combining information from different senses
subthemes.gist: Merging information from images, sound, text, and other data sources so models understand situations from multiple angles at once.

subthemes.name: Stopping models from making things up
subthemes.gist: Preventing models from confidently stating false information when they process images and text, checking against what they actually see.

subthemes.name: Reasoning about space and objects
subthemes.gist: Teaching models to understand where things are located, how objects relate to each other, and what the physical layout looks like in images.

subthemes.name: Learning from tiny amounts of data
subthemes.gist: Training models that work well even when given very few examples, so they can adapt to new tasks quickly without massive datasets.

subthemes.name: Running models efficiently
subthemes.gist: Making models faster and smaller so they can run on phones and edge devices without losing accuracy or requiring expensive hardware.

subthemes.name: Training models better
subthemes.gist: Using new techniques like reinforcement learning and preference optimization to train models that follow human judgment more closely.

subthemes.name: Specialized domain understanding
subthemes.gist: Applying multimodal models to specific fields like medicine, remote sensing, and architecture where they need to understand technical diagrams and specialized data.
